pages.title: Maritime Montering

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Maritime Montering, established 1981, with the intent to deliver innovative and high quality ship interior to vessels and rigs. After almost four decades in the industry, we are proud to have successfully completed more than 1,100 projects.
Today we are on the course of a new jorney inroducing next generation accomodation to provide our customers a memorable excperience at sea. We have offices across the european and asian continent and our 700+ employees are ready to serve our clients.
Nordic design and accomodation since 1981
Nordic design is a heritage that we strive to live up to through stylish design, high quality furniture, sustainable materials, and long-lasting accommodation quality.
The headquarters of Maritime Montering is situated in the western part of Norway between mountaintops and fjords, where marine life has always been a central resource for the local communities and businesses.
Today we are an international supplier with offices and representatives in several countries around the world.
As a full turnkey provider, we offer newbuilding, refits, and modernization of all inside accommodation and interior living areas. We also provide a full lifecycle support to owners and shipyards, and for those who seek security and lifecycle support.
Values
Our values sets the foundation of what we care the most about. It`s the guideline and purpose for all our employees around the world.
Career
Here at Maritime Montering, we’ve set our targets high. Leading the path in sustainable accommodation and to deliver carbon neutral accommodation by 2025. This fast transformation isn’t for everyone. But if you’re excited by the technological and sustainability challenges facing the marine industry and society at large, then you’re a perfect fit.
At Maritime Montering, we are truly diverse which makes us a better company. By sharing knowledge across teams, our clients benefit from our global experience.
The transparency act
The Act shall promote enterprises’ respect for fundamental human rights and decent working conditions in connection with the production of goods and the provision of services and ensure the general public access to information regarding how enterprises address adverse impacts on fundamental human rights and decent working conditions. A good and safe working environment is central to Maritime Montering’s strategy, and the group has a clear goal of ensuring a sustainable and responsible supply chain.
Read more here:
The transparency act
